text:
marta: Quick debrief from this morning's micro-A/B: three variants (v3-rapid, v3-int4, v3-ens) landed ~even. overall MRR diffs tiny. latency: v3-rapid best, cost: v3-int4 best, concordance: v3-ens slightly higher. we need a clear promote rule.

theo: Ugh three-way ties are annoying. Can we define ordered criteria with early exits? e.g. 1) safety checks (hallucination, toxicity) must pass 2) if safety equal, use slice-weighted MRR 3) if within epsilon, prefer lower cost 4) if still tied, choose lowest p99 latency 5) deterministic fallback by model name

priya: Agree on ordering. Add one more early abort: if any variant increases hallucination_rate > 0.2% vs baseline -> immediate rollback. Also require kv_warm_hit_rate >= 95% for promote. We saw v3-int4 had a slightly worse warm rate in the run.

alex: Suggest we compute a composite score: score = w1*weighted_mrr - w2*cost_pct - w3*latency_p99_ms - penalty*hallucination_rate. Make weights configurable per-promote. Default weights: w1=1.0, w2=0.25, w3=0.005, penalty=10.

marta: Nice. But we should keep a readable rule set for on-call. Let's also require a quiet-burn: 0.5% traffic for 3h, auto-fallback if any of: (i) composite_score drops by >=0.6% OR (ii) any top-3 slice mrr drops >=1% OR (iii) p99 latency regresses >=120ms.

theo: Good thresholds. Also recommend instrumenting an "explainable_decision" field in rollout events with which rule fired and numeric deltas so audit is clear.

deploy-bot: A/B artifacts uploaded: https://ci.internal/ab/1742204321-report.html (summary: v3-rapid mrr_diff=0.12%, v3-int4 mrr_diff=0.09%, v3-ens mrr_diff=0.18%; cost_diffs: -6.2%, -12.4%, +4.5%; latency_p99_deltas: -28ms, +10ms, +15ms)

priya: I'll push a promote_policy proto with ordered checks + composite scoring and default weights. Will also add unit tests for hallucination abort and kv_warm thresholds.

alex: Make sure rollout-service logs sample counts per slice and a hash of the evaluation dataset used. Otherwise we get noisy promotes.

marta: Ops note: add an emergency manual-abort toggle that bypasses automated promote if SOC triggers. Put that in the PR.

ops-bot: Incident stub created: INC-2026-174220 (placeholder in case of post-promote rollback).

marta: Cool. Priya, can you run a replay with ~20k longdoc + convo + code slices tonight and post slice-level deltas here tomorrow? We'll land policy after that and run the quiet-burn.

priya: On it. Will also collect cost-per-1000-tokens and coldstart_kv misses.

marta: Thanks everyone — target to merge policy PR tomorrow AM.
